entry.name: intelliHideMode
entry.label: Window avoidance: 0 all windows, 1 focused application, 2 maximized windows, 3 always on top.

entry.name: showDelay
entry.label: Delay before revealing the dock, in seconds.

entry.name: hideDelay
entry.label: Delay before hiding the dock, in seconds.

entry.name: animationTime
entry.label: Dock movement animation duration, in seconds.

entry.name: hideInFullscreen
entry.label: Prevent edge reveal while a fullscreen window occupies the screen.

entry.name: dockPosition
entry.label: Screen edge: 0 top, 1 right, 2 bottom, 3 left.

entry.name: visualStyle
entry.label: The dock background style.

entry.name: iconSize
entry.label: The preferred icon size in pixels, subject to available panel space.

entry.name: magnification
entry.label: Enlarge icons around the pointer.

entry.name: magnificationFactor
entry.label: The maximum magnification scale.

entry.name: magnificationSpread
entry.label: The number of neighboring icons affected by magnification.

entry.name: launchBounce
entry.label: Animate application icons while launching.

entry.name: danceUrgent
entry.label: Animate application icons when a window needs attention.

entry.name: dimMinimized
entry.label: Dim applications whose windows are minimized.

entry.name: minimizedOpacity
entry.label: The opacity of minimized applications.

entry.name: indicatorStyle
entry.label: The running application indicator style.

entry.name: customColor
entry.label: The custom background color.

entry.name: customizeIndicators
entry.label: Use custom running indicator colors and outlines.

entry.name: indicatorColor
entry.label: The custom running indicator color.

entry.name: indicatorBorderColor
entry.label: The custom running indicator outline color.

entry.name: indicatorBorderWidth
entry.label: The running indicator outline width.

entry.name: dominantIndicatorColor
entry.label: Use each application's dominant icon color for its indicator.

entry.name: unityBacklit
entry.label: Illuminate the background of running application icons.

entry.name: glossyIcons
entry.label: Add a glossy highlight to application icon backgrounds.

entry.name: showEmblems
entry.label: Show application icon emblems and progress.

entry.name: showNotificationCounter
entry.label: Show notification counts on application icons.

entry.name: applicationCounterOverridesNotifications
entry.label: Prefer an application's own count to its notification count.

entry.name: transparencyMode
entry.label: Background transparency: 0 fixed, 1 adaptive, 2 theme.

entry.name: minAlpha
entry.label: The minimum background opacity in adaptive mode.

entry.name: maxAlpha
entry.label: The maximum background opacity in adaptive mode.

entry.name: backgroundOpacity
entry.label: The background opacity.

entry.name: cornerRadius
entry.label: The background corner radius.

entry.name: compact
entry.label: Reduce spacing around dock items.

entry.name: showRunning
entry.label: Show running applications in the dock.

entry.name: showFavorites
entry.label: Show pinned applications in the dock.

entry.name: showApplications
entry.label: Show the application launcher button.

entry.name: showAppsAtStart
entry.label: Place the application launcher before task icons.

entry.name: showAppsAction
entry.label: Application button action: 0 application launcher, 1 application stack.

entry.name: applicationsStack
entry.label: Show the Applications stack.

entry.name: documentsStack
entry.label: Show the Documents stack.

entry.name: downloadsStack
entry.label: Show the Downloads stack.

entry.name: homeStack
entry.label: Show the Home stack.

entry.name: customFolders
entry.label: Folder URLs shown as stacks.

entry.name: stackView
entry.label: Default stack view: 0 automatic, 1 fan, 2 grid, 3 list.

entry.name: stackSort
entry.label: Default stack sort: 0 name, 1 date, 2 kind.

entry.name: stackOverrides
entry.label: Per-stack view and sorting preferences, encoded as JSON.

entry.name: stackItemLimit
entry.label: The maximum number of items shown in each stack.

entry.name: stacksDivider
entry.label: Show a divider between applications and stacks.

entry.name: showRecentApps
entry.label: Show recently used applications.

entry.name: recentAppsLimit
entry.label: The maximum number of recent applications.

entry.name: showTrash
entry.label: Show Trash in the dock.

entry.name: showDevices
entry.label: Show removable devices in the dock.

entry.name: showNetworkDevices
entry.label: Show network locations in the dock.

entry.name: devicesOnlyMounted
entry.label: Only show mounted removable devices.

entry.name: clickAction
entry.label: The action when clicking an application.

entry.name: shiftClickAction
entry.label: The action when Shift-clicking an application.

entry.name: middleClickDockAction
entry.label: The action when middle-clicking an application in the dock.

entry.name: shiftMiddleClickAction
entry.label: The action when Shift-middle-clicking an application.

entry.name: dockScrollAction
entry.label: Dock scrolling: 0 none, 1 cycle application windows, 2 switch desktops.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentScreen
entry.label: Whether to show only window tasks that are on the same screen as the widget.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentDesktop
entry.label: Whether to only show tasks that are on the current virtual desktop.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentActivity
entry.label: Whether to show only tasks that are on the current activity.

entry.name: showOnlyMinimized
entry.label: Whether to show only window tasks that are minmized.

entry.name: unhideOnAttention
entry.label: Whether to unhide if a window wants attention.

entry.name: groupingStrategy
entry.label: How tasks are grouped: 0 = Do Not Group, 1 = By Program Name

entry.name: groupedTaskVisualization
entry.label: What happens when clicking on a grouped task: 0 = cycle through grouped tasks, 1 = try to show tooltips, 2 = try to show present Windows effect, 3 = show textual list (AKA group dialog)

entry.name: groupPopups
entry.label: Whether groups are to be reduced to a single task button and expand into a popup or task buttons are grouped on the widget itself.

entry.name: onlyGroupWhenFull
entry.label: Whether to group always or only when the widget runs out of space to show additional task buttons comfortably.

entry.name: groupingAppIdBlacklist
entry.label: The id's (usually .desktop file names) of applications that should not have their tasks grouped.

entry.name: groupingLauncherUrlBlacklist
entry.label: The launcher URLs (usually .desktop file or executable URLs) of applications that should not have their tasks grouped.

entry.name: sortingStrategy
entry.label: Values from TaskManager::TasksModel::SortMode

entry.name: separateLaunchers
entry.label: Whether launcher tasks are sorted separately at the left side of the widget or can be mixed with other tasks.

entry.name: hideLauncherOnStart
entry.label: Whether launcher tasks should be hidden when their application is launched.

entry.name: maxStripes
entry.label: The maximum number of rows (in a horizontal-orientation containment, i.e. panel) or columns (in a vertical-orientation containment) to layout task buttons in.

entry.name: forceStripes
entry.label: Whether to try and always layout task buttons in as many rows/columns as set via maxStripes.

entry.name: showToolTips
entry.label: Whether to show tooltips when hovering task buttons.

entry.name: taskMaxWidth
entry.label: Tune the max width of task items.

entry.name: wheelEnabled
entry.label: Whether using the mouse wheel with the mouse pointer above the widget should switch between tasks.

entry.name: wheelSkipMinimized
entry.label: Whether to skip minimized tasks when switching between them using the mouse wheel.

entry.name: highlightWindows
entry.label: Whether to request the window manager highlight windows when hovering corresponding task tooltips.

entry.name: launchers
entry.label: The list of launcher tasks on the widget. Usually .desktop file or executable URLs. Special URLs such as preferred://browser that expand to default applications are supported.

entry.name: middleClickAction
entry.label: What to do on middle-mouse click on a task button.

entry.name: indicateAudioStreams
entry.label: Whether to indicate applications that are playing audio.

entry.name: interactiveMute
entry.label: Whether to mute applications that are playing audio using audio indicators.

entry.name: tooltipControls
entry.label: Whether to show media and volume controls in the tooltip.

entry.name: fill
entry.label: Whether task manager should occupy all available space.

entry.name: taskHoverEffect
entry.label: Whether task buttons should change in appearance when the mouse pointer is above them.

entry.name: maxTextLines
entry.label: The maximum number of text lines to show in a task button. 0 means no limit.

entry.name: minimizeActiveTaskOnClick
entry.label: Whether to minimize the currently-active task when clicked. If false, clicking on the currently-active task will do nothing.

entry.name: reverseMode
entry.label: Whether to grow the tasks in according to system configuration or opposite to system configuration.

entry.name: iconSpacing
entry.label: Spacing between icons in task manager. Margin is multiplied by this value.
